source_candidates.rationale: Canonical two-commit delivery means exactly two task-authored commits on the delivery branch above its start SHA before Human promotion. The legacy ingest validator uses git rev-list --count BASE..HEAD on main after the Human merge, counting the merge commit as a third commit. Remediation must make the validator merge-aware and preserve detection of unauthorized third task commits.

state_gate_resolver._path_allowed() does not normalize .. segments; manual reachability probe confirms docs/workforce/../backend/x.py is accepted against a docs/workforce/ allowed path. The resolver is a canonical authorization primitive callable from both authorize_task and as a CLI operation, so unnormalized input can reach it.

Python fnmatch.fnmatch makes a single * match across directory separators, so docs/workforce/* matches docs/workforce/deep/sub/x.py. Existing task packages use ** for recursion, but B027/Authority does not explicitly define whether * means one component or recursive. The schema and runtime contract need an explicit wildcard path-scope semantics decision before any single-* task package is authorized.
